s: We have also standardized on our blanks, getting great pricing from Alstyle - American Apparel blanks are $$$$ around $3.80 to $4.50 per blank - when you add printing and development costs on top of $4.50, throw in the price of your shipping bag, labor to pick and pack you simply cannot sell your tee for $9 and make any money - so our blank price has to be just right for this to work - put it this way, if tomorrow the only shirt size we sold was XXL then we would be in trouble since the XXL are about .50 more than the blanks S thru XL. When you buy a Tee in the mall for say $15 - the shop in the mall has probably purchased this Tee at a wholesale price of around $7.50 - so the OEM of the tee is still making money even though they are selling the tee wholesale at $7.50.
